answer: Each identity climbs a public timber ladder. Rung one costs 40, burned; rung k costs 40 plus 9 per rung below it, so fakes get pricier. Each rung passes the public forge, stamping the owner's key. Each rung carries an echo of the hash beneath; a rented rung bears a stranger's stamp; the mismatch burns the 70-credit bond. 1,000 rungs cost 4,535,500 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its share.
